segments.name: Firearms
segments.description: Designs, manufactures and sells rifles, pistols, revolvers and shotguns to federally-licensed independent wholesale distributors serving the commercial sporting market.
segments.evidence: The firearms segment manufactures and sells rifles, pistols, and revolvers principally to a number of federally-licensed, independent wholesale distributors primarily located in the United States.

segments.name: Castings
segments.description: Manufactures steel investment castings and metal injection molding parts mainly for internal use by the firearms segment, with minimal outside sales.
segments.evidence: The castings segment manufactures and sells steel investment castings and metal injection molding parts.

revenueModel.text: The Company is paid by federally-licensed independent wholesale distributors who purchase firearms directly from the Company and resell to retail dealers, plus limited direct sales of castings to outside customers.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company's firearms are primarily marketed through a network of federally licensed, independent wholesale distributors who purchase the products directly from the Company.
